title: applyLists does not reconcile pending list saves on a record re-read
evidence: Done 2026-11-14: apply now starts the waiting list saves whose erase is still shown (list-saves.ts flushShown, exposed as useListSaves flushListSaves, called beside flushPendingSave), so the lists it shows hold the edit; a save from an erase no longer shown is skipped, with no write or WRITE_REFUSED at the flush; it waits as before (this tab's erase drops it; otherwise its timer fires and the store refuses and reports it, as before). Pins: HealthTool.record-read-pins.test.tsx H52 (medication + remote re-read; upload screening date), useListSaves.test.tsx H52. Was: widget-src/src/hooks/useRecordApply.ts apply calls applyLists(result), which sets the medications, screenings and supplements the read returned; a medication, screening or supplement save still waiting on its 300 ms timer in widget-src/src/hooks/useListSaves.ts (medSaves, screeningSaves, supplementSaves) is neither flushed, dropped nor laid back over the read. So a whole re-read inside that window shows the stored list, then the waiting save lands, and the screen keeps the list from before the edit while the record holds the edit. Every refused-save re-read (reread 'refused' / 'left') shares it; lead A6 (PR 1382) keeps an aborted erase from re-reading unless it refused a save, and US-16 AC2a names the rest as a Limit. Found by Codex on PR 1382 (R1, a dose changed just before Delete all my data)
